Narration and dialogue are referenced by beat and line order in the locked screenplay (single source of truth for the Arabic text); the engine extracts them. Characters resolve through casting.json; LOC/VEH/PRP/WRD IDs resolve from the studio library; look/lens keys from studio/library/looks/looks.json via production_config.json. lip_sync defaults to 'avoid' unless a shot says otherwise. Durations are planning targets in seconds.
